settings.title: A practical guide to selecting the right aluminum entrance matting for commercial projects

settings.text:
Entrance matting plays a key role in building safety, cleanliness, and long-term floor protection. This specification guide outlines how Aluminum Entrance Matting systems perform across commercial applications, from interior lobbies to exterior entryways.

It provides a clear overview of indoor and outdoor solutions, along with essential specification considerations such as traffic levels, moisture control, slip resistance, and structural requirements, supporting informed, specification-ready decisions for architectural projects.

Download the guide to confidently specify the right aluminum entrance matting system.

Specification Guide for Educational Buildings

Educational buildings are subject to heavy, concentrated foot traffic throughout the day. Properly specified entrance matting helps improve safety, reduce tracked-in moisture and debris, and support long-term floor protection in learning environments.
